FLUX 3 Image Klein on Mac: files, RAM and published times

Distilled 5.6B text-to-image and editing model with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct as the text encoder. The FLUX Kommunity License limits model use to non-commercial work, with an output exception below US$5,000,000 revenue.

Black Forest Labs · Updated 2026-10-24
Answer

FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on a Mac with 32 GB or more. A published run on M1 Max · 32 GB used the mflux 4-bit build (source, 2026-10-20).

Does it fit your NVIDIA GPU's VRAM?

Runs · Stated means the linked model card, app maker or NVIDIA says a GPU with that much VRAM runs the model; Runs · Published names the card of a dated run. Fits with offload means the main model weights fit in VRAM with a 15% margin but the full set does not: the text encoder and VAE run from system RAM, which is slower. Exceeds VRAM means even the main weights are too large for the card. Mac runs never count here.

Which Mac software routes are listed?

  • Diffusers

    Official

    Formats: safetensors, gguf. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    Runs on the PyTorch mps device on Mac and CUDA on NVIDIA. GGUF loads through from_single_file on the model class, not the pipeline. Resident size is the sum of the weights, an upper bound.

    Sources: Diffusers MPS guide · Diffusers GGUF guide

  • mflux

    Community · 0.23.0

    Formats: safetensors. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    MLX-native runner. It reads the original Hugging Face weights and quantizes them while loading (--quantize 3, 4, 5, 6 or 8). --low-ram lowers memory use at a performance cost.

    Install with uv

    uv tool install --upgrade mflux

    Sources: mflux README, install · mflux pyproject · mflux common README, quantization

  • stable-diffusion.cpp

    Official

    Formats: gguf, safetensors. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    C/C++ runner with Metal on Mac and CUDA on NVIDIA. It reads GGUF and safetensors, and its docs keep a page per model family. Resident size is the sum of the weights, an upper bound.

    Sources: stable-diffusion.cpp README, backends

What does the official configuration say?

"Peak GPU memory with the reference code on a B200 at 1024x1024 with the prompt upsampler off is 31 GB in BF16, 26 GB in FP8 and 25 GB in NVFP4. This is a datacenter GPU figure, not a Mac minimum."

Source: FLUX 3 Image Klein model card · Read 2026-10-24.

What known issues should you check?

  • Known issue 1

    Black Forest Labs says not to use the model without a prompt upsampler. The upsampler is a separate 9B model and is not counted in the sizes here.

    Source: FLUX 3 Image Klein model card · Read 2026-10-24

  • Known issue 2

    The Mac timings come from a run with other applications active and growing swap. The authors call them observations under shared load, not a speed ranking.

    Source: mflux FLUX 3 memory benchmark · Read 2026-10-24

Frequently asked questions

How fast is FLUX 3 Image Klein on a Mac?

An mflux 4-bit conversion on an M1 Max with 32 GB made a 512x512 image in 16 steps in 49.45 s in default mode, peaking at 6.71 GB of MLX memory. Low-RAM mode took 52.63 s with a 3.997 GB peak. Other applications were running.

Do I need the FLUX 3 prompt upsampler?

Black Forest Labs says not to use the model without a prompt upsampler. It is a separate 9B model and is not counted in the file sizes here, so those sizes understate the official workflow.

Can I use FLUX 3 Image Klein commercially?

Ordinary model use is non-commercial under the FLUX Kommunity License v1.0. Output generation has an exception for qualifying users below US$5,000,000 gross annualized revenue. Read the license text for the full list of prohibited uses.
